brief: mobile-first food delivery cart and checkout

defects.what: An empty 'Promo' row shows in the summary because [hidden] is overridden by display:flex
Breakdown popover covers the tip and total it explains; cut off at 390px
Fee breakdown only reachable through a 22px info button
Order summary and total sit at the bottom after seven cards; never visible on phone without scrolling
On phone 'Remove' wraps to its own line, leaving ragged loosely attached action rows
Remove is a muted link with a ~28px hit area; minus at quantity 1 silently removes the item
At 390px the long address runs under the 'Change' link
Brand red used for primary, links, selection and (almost) error, so red says nothing
Section headings and sub-amounts are small and low contrast
Place order commits with no recap beside it; confirmation's back link allows placing it again
Sheet has no close or cancel; new address commits silently on Done
Disabled 'Confirm time' label hard to read in both themes
23 slots in one undivided grid; focus ring on 'Today' looks like a selection
defects.note: The focus-ring part may come from the harness: surfaces are opened with a scripted click, and Chrome shows focus rings when there was no real pointer input.

defects.what: 'Default wallet' label contradicts the preselected default card
Undo toast covers cards for six seconds while the total jumps with no other signal

reviewer: Claude Sonnet, blind review of screenshots and source (never saw the rule list)
